cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, reflective atmosphere established by a solitary melodic motif, which persists through the verses to convey a sense of isolation and introspection.
cards.palette: A clean, arpeggiated electric guitar serves as the primary harmonic and melodic anchor, playing a repetitive, melancholic pattern that remains present from the Intro through to the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing the neon shadows dancing on the wet pavement stone
Counting the heavy secrets that I carry on my own
Static in my head like a radio lost in the gray
Watching the ghosts of the city slowly fade away
I’m trading my peace for a crown made of heavy sighs
Looking for truth in the blink of a thousand lies
Wrapped in a blanket of thoughts that never go to sleep
Walking the line between the promises that I keep
[Chorus]
Chasing the echoes in the hollow of the night
Searching for fire in a world losing its light
Heavy is the heart that beats beneath the skin
Wondering where the ending meets where I begin
[Verse]
Tracing the ghosts of the people I used to be
Drowning in thoughts like a ship lost in the sea
The streetlights flicker like a heartbeat skipping a beat
I’m finding my rhythm in the middle of the street
Tired of the masks that I wear just to fit in
Fighting the battles that are raging deep within
A lonely road is the only road I call my home
Walking through the crowd, yet feeling all alone
[Chorus]
Chasing the echoes in the hollow of the night
Searching for fire in a world losing its light
Heavy is the heart that beats beneath the skin
Wondering where the ending meets where I begin
[Bridge]
The rain is falling like a secret whispered low
Nowhere left to run and nowhere left to go
[Chorus]
Chasing the echoes in the hollow of the night
Searching for fire in a world losing its light
Heavy is the heart that beats beneath the skin
Wondering where the ending meets where I begin
[Outro]
